contexts.text: The stench from that Hell (of hatred, made me) vomit.
From those who have lived in hatred and revenge there exhale spheres which... excite vomiting.
One of those called the Luke warm came to me... and the Spirits then felt... as when men are moved to vomiting. SE 793.
When the sphere of those who have contracted a nature from simulation is turned into an odour, there is a vomitory stench. SE 1045.
Evil would spew out good as something vomitory.
At the mere thought of spiritual good and truth... they felt like what (here) excites vomiting.
When the Hells are slightly opened... they excite vomiting. TCR 569:5.

I will vomit thee out of My mouth () = to be separated from the Lord; and to be thus separated from Him, is to be in neither Heaven nor Hell, but in a place apart, bereaved of human life, where there are mere phantasies. The reason is that they have commingled truths with falsities, and goods with evils, thus holy things with profane, to such a degree that they cannot be separated... ( = separation from the Knowledges which are from the Word: not that the Lord separates them from Himself, but that they separate themselves from the Lord. To vomit out is mentioned, because it is treating of the Luke warm, and what is Luke warm... causes vomiting out, which is from the correspondence. Explained. AE 235.)

It is said of these that they are vomited out, because the World of Spirits... corresponds to the stomach... and the things which are vomited out of the stomach are those which have not been separated (from what is excrementitious). It is on account of this correspondence that to be vomited out, and vomiting, are mentioned in the following passages. Illustrated. TCR 132:end. TCR 683:end.
(Infernal spheres by which) I was compelled to vomit out my food... the effect being vomiting.
Their state was represented by an infant... which vomited out milk. Explained.
(The persuasive sphere of the Antediluvians causes vomiting in others.)
The reason lukewarm water causes vomiting. Explained.

On Dutchmen who pass their time in a vomitory stench... Some Societies of the Dutch, where are those whose wives have domineered over them... collected vessels full of vomit, and held their nostrils over them, being deliciated with this stench.
Both these separations are meant by being vomited out of the mouth. Fully illustrated.
Of falsified truth is predicated shameful vomit ().
Hence it is that from the brothels in the Hells there flow forth stenches which excite vomiting. AE 1005:end.
